            q=Q[i,j]; m=np.max(q); best=[k for k in range(3) if q[k]==m]
            a=np.random.choice(best)
        nobs,r,term,trunc,_=env.step(a)
        done=term or trunc
        ni,nj=disc(nobs)
        tgt=r+gamma*np.max(Q[ni,nj])*(0 if done else 1)

def step_model(p,v,a):
